information.name: mikrotik-service-sync
information.description: Automatically synchronize UCRM service status with Mikrotik address lists for service suspension and activation using Mikrotik REST API. Processes webhooks for service events and runs daily sync to ensure all services are in the correct state.
information.author: Jim Bouse - jimbouse.com

configuration.label: Mikrotik IP Addresses
configuration.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses or hostnames (e.g., '192.168.1.1, 192.168.1.2, 192.168.1.3')

configuration.label: Mikrotik REST API Port
configuration.description: REST API port (443 for HTTPS recommended, 80 for HTTP only in test environments)

configuration.label: Enable HTTPS
configuration.description: Enable HTTPS for secure REST API connection (recommended - requires www-ssl service enabled on Mikrotik)

configuration.label: Ignore Certificate Errors
configuration.description: Ignore SSL certificate validation errors (useful for self-signed certificates)

configuration.label: DHCP Server Name
configuration.description: Name of the DHCP server in Mikrotik (e.g., 'default'). Leave blank to search all DHCP leases regardless of server.

configuration.label: Service Active Address List Name
configuration.description: Address list name for active services. Leave blank to use default 'Service_Active'

configuration.label: Service Suspend Address List Name
configuration.description: Address list name for suspended services. Leave blank to use default 'Service_Suspend'

configuration.label: Service End Address List Name
configuration.description: Address list name for ended services. Leave blank to use default 'Service_End'

configuration.label: UCRM Serial or MAC Custom Attribute Key
configuration.description: The custom attribute key/ID number on service profile containing the serial or MAC to lookup in DHCP (e.g., 5, 12, etc.)

configuration.label: DHCP Lease Column to Search
configuration.description: Choose which column in the Mikrotik DHCP lease table to search for the device

configuration.label: Enable Debug Logging
configuration.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting
